tagline: 徕卡便携相机，1999 年发布
description: 徕卡于1999年推出的便携相机。配备Leica Vario-Elmar 1:4-1:10,5/38-105 mm zoom (7 separate lenses with 2 apsherical lens surfaces)。快门速度1,7 - 1/500 sec.。Active infrared system。

specs.镜头: Leica Vario-Elmar 1:4-1:10,5/38-105 mm zoom (7 separate lenses with 2 apsherical lens surfaces)
specs.取景器: real image type, showing AF measuring area, enlargement 0.375x to 1.05x
specs.闪光灯: reaching as far as 3.2 meters for a 100 ASA film with lens in wide angle position
specs.英文简介: The Leica C1 was one of the compact cameras offered by Leica Camera AG.
